title: An upright changes the ticket
summary: Miami’s late touchdown made it a seven-point game, but Riley Patterson missed the extra point. Cincinnati’s 31–24 win covered a documented -6.5 line by half a point.

timeline.label: Late fourth quarter
timeline.text: Miami answered Cincinnati’s field goal with a touchdown.

timeline.label: 0:45 remaining
timeline.text: Patterson’s extra-point attempt hit the left upright.

unusual: The missed kick preserved the seven-point margin. A successful extra point would instead have left a six-point margin.
explanations: The difference is ordinary spread arithmetic, not evidence of player intent.
questions: Lines varied across books and times; -7 would push at this final score.

sources.label: Dolphins: scoring sequence and final score
CBS game tracker: missed extra point

betting.provenance: Sports Illustrated’s Week 5 pregame preview identifies FanDuel at Bengals -6.5.
betting.outcome: 31 − 24 = 7. Cincinnati covers by 0.5; Miami +6.5 loses by 0.5.
betting.caution: A -7/+7 ticket pushes. This is not a claim about all closing prices.

potential_bets.impact: Verified quoted line: Miami lost by seven, so +6.5 lost; a made extra point would have changed the margin to six, all else equal.
At +7 the final margin would push, not lose; settlement depends on the actual purchased line.
